decoded.meaning: POINT{ NAME "s", POINT{ NAME "adc0", VALUE{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE i32[3]={0,1500,-250}, three u16 sample frames } } } — the frame a propagate(/s, FOLD) sweep emits when the swept STORED vertex /s/adc0 holds a composed batch. One branch-write frame for the subtree, RFC-0005 §B node shape, root carrying its leading NAME (RFC-0025 §4.1.2 clause 5)
decoded.note: the batch bytes at offset 17 are stream/batch-composed-folded VERBATIM — the fold moved a value it did not read. This is the vector that proves RFC-0025 §4.1.3 clause 2: the app's composition is the whole of the mechanism, and the fold needed ZERO graph change to carry it. The graph derives no time, holds no flush counter or window, and never learns the value is a batch
